name: cdhai-social-media-officer-linkedin
description: LinkedIn post generator for CDHAI / Johns Hopkins Carey Business School. Takes a folder with a filled-in Word content template plus supporting materials. Uses Codex's native multimodal capabilities for all vision, paper analysis, and LLM work — no external OpenAI API key required. Auto-invokes cdhai-content-reviewer as a Codex sub-agent for independent quality review. Produces a Word draft with inline embedded images and a single merged verification report. Includes image diversity constraints (no single subject dominates picks) and mandatory usage-rights verification for web-sourced images.
triggers: I want to draft a LinkedIn post
generate a LinkedIn post from my folder

required_inputs.content_template: .docx with Purpose, Post Type, Date, Key Points sections

openai.note: All AI work now done by Codex natively. The openai package is no longer a dependency.

codex_native.purpose: Multimodal vision (image description, face comparison), LLM text analysis (paper, post generation, reviewer checks), structured output.

codex_imagegen.purpose: AI image generation (Tier 3 option b). Uses Codex's ChatGPT plan allocation.

web_image_search.purpose: Tier 3 option (c). Bing Images / DuckDuckGo via HTML scraping. No API key.
web_image_search.warning: Web-sourced images require manual usage-rights verification before posting.

serpapi.purpose: Cleaner Tier 2 face-identification web search. Falls back to DuckDuckGo HTML if absent.

web_access.purpose: Tier 2 face identification fetches official faculty/staff pages; Tier 3 (c) searches the web for images.

v0_4_2_architecture.principle: All AI/vision/LLM work performed by Codex natively. Helpers are deterministic only.
mitigations: Reviewer runs as Codex sub-agent (independent context, fresh-eyes pass)
Image processing in batches of 5 (avoid context window pressure)
Strict JSON output specs in SKILL.md with examples
